```{r, loadpackages}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(httr2)



```


```{r, getrecentobservations}

#Define ebird API key.
api_key <- Sys.getenv("api_key")

#headers = c(
#  'X-eBirdApiToken' = api_key
#)

#res <- VERB("GET", url = "https://api.ebird.org/v2/data/obs/KZ/recent", add_headers(headers))

#cat(content(res, 'text'))

recent_obs <- request("https://api.ebird.org/v2/data/obs/KZ/recent") |> 
  req_headers(
    `X-eBirdApiToken` = api_key,
  ) |> 
  req_perform() |>
  resp_body_json()

#Create dataframe of recent observations.
recent_obs_df <- data.frame(
  common_name = unlist(lapply(recent_obs, FUN = function(x) {x$comName})),
  sub_id = unlist(lapply(recent_obs, FUN = function(x) {x$subId})),
  species_code = unlist(lapply(recent_obs, FUN = function(x) {x$speciesCode})),
  loc_name = unlist(lapply(recent_obs, FUN = function(x) {x$locName}))
)

```

## Column {width = "65%"}

### Row {height = "10%"}

```{r, sendtoojs}
#| echo: false
#| include: false

ojs_define(recent_obs_ojs = recent_obs_df)
```

```{ojs}
//| expandable: false

// Transpose the data to make it usable in ojs.
recent_observations = transpose(recent_obs_ojs)

// Create a dropdown menu of the species common name.
viewof nameDropdown = Inputs.select(
  recent_observations.map(d => d.common_name),
  {
    label: "Choose a species",
    unique: true
    }
)
```


### Row {height = "70%"}

```{ojs, embedHTML}
html`<iframe 
  width="100%" 
  height="800" 
  loading="lazy"
  src="https://ebird.org/species/${recent_observations.find(d => d.common_name === nameDropdown)?.species_code || 'gretit1'}">
</iframe>`
```
